invalid_schema_400.json.purpose: provider rejects the exact published schema; must be non-retryable INVALID_REQUEST and stop the line per spec §6.4

context_length_400.json.purpose: context window exceeded under truncation=disabled; finish_reason=context_window_exceeded, non-retryable

rate_limit_429.json.purpose: retryable rate limit; adapter must not retry itself (single HTTP call)

server_500.json.purpose: server error is retryable PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE; also reused at status 503 by tests

success_reasoning_then_message.json.purpose: completed response with a reasoning item before the unique final message; proves no output[0] assumption; full usage incl. cache_write and reasoning tokens; resolved model is the alias target gpt-5.6-sol

refusal.json.purpose: completed response whose only content is a refusal item; REFUSED, never JSON-parsed

incomplete_max_output_no_visible.json.purpose: incomplete due to max_output_tokens with zero visible text; empty visible artifact is required, not a parser bug

incomplete_content_filter_partial.json.purpose: incomplete due to content_filter with a partial JSON fragment; must stay INCOMPLETE, never upgraded to success

failed_server_error.json.purpose: top-level failed response with error.code=server_error; retryable PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE with raw kept

nonterminal_in_progress.json.purpose: unexpected non-terminal status on a synchronous call; FAILED unknown provider failure

completed_no_message.json.purpose: completed with only a reasoning item; missing structured output is a parse failure

completed_multiple_output_text.json.purpose: two output_text items; must fail closed instead of output_text concatenation

completed_commentary_then_final.json.purpose: visible commentary phase message before final_answer; commentary is an unexpected item, never concatenated

completed_invalid_json.json.purpose: markdown-fenced truncated output; no fence stripping or regex repair, OUTPUT_PARSE_FAILED

completed_json_array_root.json.purpose: valid JSON with non-object root; OUTPUT_SCHEMA_INVALID

unexpected_tool_call.json.purpose: function_call item on a tool-less request; protocol failure and the tool is never executed

resolved_model_mismatch.json.purpose: resolved model outside the allowlist; fails closed before content normalization, raw/visible kept

usage_unavailable.json.purpose: usage missing entirely; nulls plus sorted limitation, never fabricated zeros

success_local_constraint_violation.json.purpose: portable-schema-valid JSON that violates a local-only Pydantic constraint; adapter must return SUCCEEDED and leave rejection to the executor's local validation (spec §15.3)
